trialBalance.title: Trial Balance
trialBalance.subtitle: A best-effort trial balance derived from this single-entry invoice ledger -- not a formal double-entry trial balance. Any imbalance is reported, never forced to zero.
trialBalance.selectCompanyPrompt: Select a company to view its trial balance.
trialBalance.imbalanceWarning: Debits and credits differ by €{amount} -- this is reported honestly, not forced to balance.

profitAndLoss.title: Profit & Loss
profitAndLoss.subtitle: All figures are accrual-basis actuals from the ledger, never an estimate. Revenue and cost-of-sales categories are only split out when transactions have been tagged with that category.

reviewCentre.title: Review & Approval Centre
reviewCentre.subtitle: Everything in this company that is waiting on a human decision -- documents with extracted data to confirm, anomaly flags to investigate, and bank transactions with a suggested match to approve. Nothing here is approved or dismissed automatically.
reviewCentre.noDocumentsWaitingReview: No documents waiting on review for this company.
reviewCentre.noOpenAnomalyFlags: No open anomaly flags for this company.

scenarios.title: Scenario Planning
scenarios.subtitle: Scenarios never touch the ledger -- every result here is recomputed on the fly from your current forecast plus the assumptions below.

kpis.title: Financial KPIs
kpis.subtitle: Every KPI shows its formula and source; where the underlying data doesn't exist, the KPI says so instead of showing a misleading number.

forecasts.title: Financial Forecasts
forecasts.subtitle: Revenue, expense, and profit forecasts are a simple trend projection from recent actuals -- never a guaranteed outcome. Outstanding-invoice and VAT figures are confirmed amounts already on the books, not projections.

government.title: Government Integration Centre
government.subtitle: Real status of this app's Dutch government integrations -- no fabricated connections. Declaration filing itself happens in Payroll Tax and VAT Returns; this page is the KVK lookup tool plus an honest integration status overview.

kvkLookup.name: KVK (Handelsregister) company lookup
kvkLookup.detail: Real network calls against KVK's published, no-registration test sandbox. Never scrapes the Handelsregister and never invents company data.

loonheffingenSubmission.name: Loonheffingen (payroll tax) submission
loonheffingenSubmission.detail: Declaration lifecycle (Draft → Submitted → Acknowledged → Accepted/Rejected) is fully built -- see Payroll Tax. Actual SBR/Digipoort transmission needs a PKIoverheid/Logius test certificate this environment cannot obtain.

vatSubmission.name: VAT (BTW) return submission
vatSubmission.detail: Return calculation and filing status are tracked in VAT Returns. Direct Belastingdienst submission has the same SBR/Digipoort certificate requirement as above.

government.sandboxTestData: Sandbox test data -- not a real Handelsregister lookup

admin.title: Platform Overview
admin.subtitle: Cross-tenant subscription, usage, and plan status for every customer account on this platform. Deliberately shows only counts -- never a customer's financial records, documents, or ledger entries.

automation.title: Automation Centre
automation.advisoryNotice: Everything here is advisory. Suggestions, detections, and anomalies always wait for an accountant to review, approve, or correct them -- nothing is posted, paid, or filed automatically.

balanceSheet.title: Balance Sheet

legalStructure.planningAidNotice: Compares estimated tax under simplified assumptions for one tax year. This never claims one structure is always best, and never writes to any real company or ledger record -- it's a planning aid only.
